tests.note: One-sided Jonckheere–Terpstra on per-claim c_i across ordinal Delta bins (n=88); permutation p (10k, seed 42). Pooled C per bin is descriptive only. Ratchet signature REJECTED (p=0.9483, Somers D=-0.309); the observed direction is flat-to-falling, consistent with the pre-registered null shape (r2_design §1a: honest forecasting predicts flat or falling conditionality near resolution). The negative trend is weak, era-fragile, and carried by the 5-10y bin (n=3); see p1_direction_summary for the E2/E3 distinction. A rejected H1 is a null result for the ratchet hypothesis, NOT a confirmed alternative (advisor ruling §2).

CI-based per design: drift >= 1.0 means the deadline recedes at least as fast as time passes (ratchet signature). n=25 restated contact-window bounds; slope_U 95% CI [-1.50, 3.00]. Each point is a restatement of a contact window in a reliable-date video (deduplicated per video/bounds).

Advisor amendment (a): JT restricted to post-2015 claims, n=88. Controls the era confound: Delta correlates with calendar date and hedge vocabulary densified over decades. HONEST NOTE: the restriction is vacuous here — every reliable-date claim in the corpus is already post-2015, so this is identical to P1; the operative era control is E3 (partial Spearman controlling date_made).
Per-claim Spearman of c_i vs -(Delta); bootstrap CI over claims (10k).

Advisor amendment (a): partial Spearman controlling date_made via rank residualization; bootstrap CI (10k, seed 42). This is the era-controlled companion to P1. Naive asymptotic two-sided p on the rank residuals is reported in the statistic block (~0.059); asymptotics on residualized ranks are approximate, so the bootstrap CI is the operative uncertainty statement. Do NOT conflate with E2's UNCONTROLLED Spearman p=0.0456: E2 does not control era, E3 does (r3 audit).

multiple_comparison_policy: 4 primary tests (P1-P4), Holm-corrected as a family at alpha=0.05; all other tests EXPLORATORY, hypothesis-generating only.
freeze_note: Design and the 50-phrase escape-hatch lexicon (verbatim from r2_design.md §1a) are frozen at git HEAD cff3988 (design round 2, loop 1); the lexicon may not be edited after the first scoring run.
stated_n_rule: Advisor ruling (b): n is stated before interpretation for every test; where n < 10 the claim is directional + CI only — the ledger is the finding, the statistic is the annotation.
p1_direction_summary: P1 ratchet signature REJECTED (one-sided JT permutation p=0.9483; Somers D=-0.309). Observed direction is flat-to-falling conditionality, consistent with the pre-registered null shape (r2_design §1a). The negative trend is weak, era-fragile, and carried by the 5-10y bin (n=3): E2 UNCONTROLLED Spearman rho=-0.214, p=0.0456; E3 ERA-CONTROLLED partial rho=-0.203, bootstrap 95% CI [-0.386, -0.0046] (upper bound grazes zero), naive asymptotic two-sided p on rank residuals=0.0592. A rejected H1 is a null result for the ratchet hypothesis, not evidence that the corpus hedges honestly (advisor ruling §2).
